title: driver/dispositions.json (the engine's answer to a verifier's findings)
description: What the engine will do about each blocking finding of one verification round, under .dabbler/runs/s<N>/driver/dispositions.json. Two actions and no third: `fix` re-enters the loop as work the next round reviews; `reject` becomes a dispute, and a dispute is refused without grounds and evidence, so a rejection here carries both or is refused before it is written. There is no word for accepting a finding without fixing it and no word for a verdict -- the engine argues or it fixes, and the verifier judges. Validated before it is written; a file that fails validation on read is refused.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the file rather than interpreting it.

seq.description: The seq of the rejection instruction that carried the findings.

round.description: The recorded round the findings belong to.

reason.description: The rebuttal's argument on `reject` -- it becomes the dispute's grounds. Optional on `fix`.

evidence_paths.description: Repository-relative cites, optionally `path:START-END`. Required on `reject`: a prose-only dispute is refused, so a prose-only rejection is refused here first.
